officialSources.observation: Shandong government report describes Changyi's integrated housing transaction, tax and property-registration service and electronic property code; it does not publish an anonymous parcel geometry service or safe parcel identifier response.
Official Shandong platform API page documents public map/WMS, place search, geocoding, imagery metadata and routing services, not a cadastral parcel feature service.
